tbesh_html:
1) to crush, pulverise, thresh
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to crush
1a2) to be fine
1b) (Hiphil) to pulverise, make dust of
1c) (Hophal) to be crushed

strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (compare H1915 (הָדַךְ)lemma הָדךְ missing vowel, corrected to הָדַךְ);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: beat in pieces (small), bruise, make dust, (into) [idiom] powder, (be, very) small, stamp (small).
